text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: Could it be that you're lacking sleep?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I was watching sports on my day off...
and found the training methods for that event quite intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I stayed up late analyzing
how this training could be utilized in the race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Pathetic. Proper rest is essential for any athlete, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thinking about training so stoically prevented Duramente from getting a good rest.
